messages:
alex: Ran a simulated ingress load against /v1/embeddings to validate fairshare. Repro attached. Seeing ~7% 413s and a lot of tiny fragments from the splitter. Need a short convo on routing/console/quotas UX.

maria: can you paste the k6 cmd + a sample request? which model and batching config?

alex: k6 run --vus 200 --duration 3m script.js
script uses mixed dims (768 / 1536) and some single-vector requests. model=redwood-embedding-large-v1
batcher config: continuous batching, max_batch_tokens=16384

curl example:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":["short text","..."],"dims":1536}'
```

Observed logs/snips:
[ingress] 2025-11-01T12:03:21Z 413 PayloadTooLarge requests=142 split_count=421 avg_frag_size=64
splitter produced many 1-2 sized fragments which is killing throughput/CPU efficiency.

sam: why are we producing 1-2 sized fragments? splitter should prefer coalescing to hit shard targets. is the dim coalescer ignoring mixed-dim affinity?

priya: we deliberately fast-split mixed dims to avoid cross-tenant coalescing and vector corruption. but we can add a min_fragment_size heuristic (eg min 8 vectors) and prefer fastfail for tiny fragments.

maria: could we add a preflight header clients can set to hint shape? e.g. X-Embedding-Shape: dims=1536,count=50 — router could route to shape-specific fastpath.

alex: proposed header: X-Embedding-Shape: dims=1536,count=50
If provided, router uses shape-specific fastpath and reduces aggressive splitting. we should also surface telemetry: ingress_fragments_per_root histogram, median_frag_size, pct_auto_fragmented.

joel: telemetry in console is essential. show: fraction auto-fragmented, median fragment size, %requests hitting 413, and a histogram of fragment counts per root. add per-tenant alert: 413_rate > 2% over 5m.

priya: rollout ops: feature-flag the dims-aware routing to 10% tenants first. quota change: introduce embedding_units = dims * count (internal) so tenants aren't surprised by byte-only quotas.

sam: changing billing calc needs finance signoff. for rollout we can expose 'dims-aware billing beta' toggle in console to collect consent and data.

alex: runtime fallback idea: if split_count > 20 for a root, route remainder to thin-quantized model or apply per-request concurrency cap to avoid CPU meltdown.

maria: i'll mock console panels. also API contract: preflight header must be optional; servers must not make hard assumptions based on it.

alex: i'll open an RFC with k6 artifacts and a suggested dashboard. next steps: priya to draft rollout plan, joel to sketch console metrics + alerts, sam to scope finance impact. @priya @joel @sam ok if i tag infra on the RFC?

priya: sgtm. also propose response preflight suggestion: {"suggested_client_split": 16, "reason":"mixed_dims"} so clients get actionable guidance.

joel: add trace spans to record fragment_id->root_id mapping for debugging and a trace tag with fragment_size.

ingress-bot: Deploy note: splitter service v2.4.1 will be canaryed to eng-platform in ~5m. Watch the splitter.fragment.discovery metric.

sam: if finance is slow, implement embedding_units internally (non-billing) first to gather a week of data before asking to change invoice logic.

alex: thanks — i'll post the RFC link and the k6 results here when ready. low-risk, roll-forward plan and console metrics look like the right path. :thumbsup:
